note: Nursing Generic BSN description names the generic track for students becoming nurses, gen ed and science in the first two years then a two-year nursing sequence; RN to BSN is for Associate's/Diploma nurses and the Accelerated BSN is for non-nursing bachelor's holders or 60+ credits. All match the programs rows.

Computer Science BS exists; the Fall 2026 plan (admitted 2026-2027) First Year Fall lists CMPS 147, MATH 110 (Quantitative Reasoning), INTD 101 and CRWT 102 at 4 credits each, totalHours 16, exactly as stated.

Sustainability Minor and Environmental Science Minor requirements (required courses, select-3 lists, 300-level note, ENSC 220/225 exclusion) match the requirement groups exactly, but it says only two minors are listed while the catalog also has an Environmental Studies Minor and a Climate Change, Policy and Action Minor.

Provost curriculum page lists ten Gen Ed courses: four keystone courses, four keystone categories and two of three distribution categories, with the 64-credit limits and the out-of-school rule. The CAP resources page says that rule is no longer enforced from Fall 2026, the catalog says Gen Ed should not exceed 41 credits, and transfers may transfer in or be waived. No exact Gen Ed credit total is published.

Accounting 4+1 description and requirement note: graduate courses start senior year and finish in the fifth year, up to three graduate courses (not over 12 credits), students must apply and be accepted, and current Accounting majors/minors may consider applying. The ASB contact row has asb@ramapo.edu, 684-7379/7380/7378 and ASB-333.

Required courses, all eight category lists, the additional Psychology course, and Career Pathways (PATH 001 twice, PATH 003) match the Psychology BA requirement groups. The Fall 2026 Psychology plan's term-by-term contents, 16-credit semesters, 128 credits and GPA 2.0 match. PSYC 101 is 4 credits with no requisites. A Psychology/Teacher Education plan for 2026 also exists.

BAAI minor requirements, the certificate policy text, the Spanish certificate mention and the Provost contact all check out. But the catalog lists a Business Essentials Certificate (ACCT 221, MKTG 290, MGMT 302 + 1 of BADM 223/INFO 224/FINC 301), a business certificate taken alongside majors. The answer omits it and implies there is only a minor for business.

Transfer FAQ says the only education degree is the BS in Elementary Education; secondary-education students complete a primary major (English, History, Mathematics, etc.) and apply to the Teacher Education Program; NJDOE-approved; GPA 3.0 or higher, apply through Teacher Education office; links ramapo.edu/te.

Courses data: INTD 101 FIRST YEAR SEMINAR, 4 credits; Student Success FAQ says FYS is a general education requirement for first-year students that must be taken in the fall semester of their first year.

Filmmaking BA introductory courses match. But it says the pages give no first-year schedule for either major, while Fall 2026 plans exist for Filmmaking/Directing, Post Production and Screenwriting (e.g. first fall INTD 101, CRWT 102, FILM 217, FILM 218) and for Communication Arts. It also calls Digital Filmmaking a Comm Arts concentration from a study-abroad page, but the catalog lists only GCM and DJW. The FYS theme and common-book details are filler.

The 11 graduate programs named match the programs table (MS Accounting, Applied Math, CS, Data Science; MBA; MFA Creative Music Technology; MSN; DNP; MPP; MSW; MA Special Education). The Graduate Admissions page lists ten of them without the MFA, plus graduate@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7270 and McBride House.

Freshmen FAQ: AP scores of 4 or 5 earn credit, sent by College Board and followed by a Transfer Credit Evaluation email. Testing pages: AB 4/5 gives Calculus I credit and BC 4/5 gives Calculus I and II. MATH 121 carries GEQR, and the catalog says transferred credit may apply to Gen Ed. No AP English Language equivalency is published, so the hedge on it is right.

Which major is better for med school is advice the data does not hold. The supporting facts check out: the 2026 plans 'Biology: General Pre-Med Track' and 'Biochemistry/Pre-Medical Track' exist; Biochemistry requires MATH 121/122, PHYS 116/117 with calculus and a long chemistry sequence; Biology has a select-2 math list, physics, an organic chemistry option rule and 4 electives.

Section instructors and open seats are not in the data. The faculty record for Yan Xu, Professor of Biology, lists Introduction to Biology (BIOL 101), correctly caveated. The Registrar page says the Fall 2026 Schedule of Classes is viewable and gives reg@ramapo.edu and 684-7695. The pronoun 'her' is not in the data (trivial).

Individual Honors decisions and schedules are personal records not in the data. The Honors first-year page says selected students are notified in early spring and lists honors@ramapo.edu; Student Success gives (201) 684-7441 and success@ramapo.edu.
